texts.value: Primary component of whey, it binds retinol and is probably involved in the transport of that molecule

Under physiological conditions beta-lactoglobulin exists as an equilibrium mixture of monomeric and dimeric forms (PubMed:10595563, PubMed:8601463, PubMed:9115437, PubMed:9760236). Interaction with LMBR1L which mediates the endocytosis of LGB has been observed in PubMed:17991420, but not in PubMed:23964685 (PubMed:17991420, PubMed:23964685)
Synthesized in mammary gland and secreted in milk
Alternate disulfide bonds occur in equal amounts in all variants examined
Several genetic variants have been identified in the cow, the most common being variants A and B that differ at positions 80 and 134. The sequence shown in this entry is that of variant B
Causes an allergic reaction in human. Is one of the causes of cow's milk allergy
Belongs to the calycin superfamily. Lipocalin family

features.description: in variant C; found only in the Jersey breed
